Romi mecha32 Robot Documentation

Intro

This project implements a modular control system for the Pololu Romi robot using MicroPython.

Subsystems

The robot software is divided into several subsystems:

  • Motor driver

  • Encoder interface

  • Line sensors

  • IMU driver

  • Task scheduling

Repository Structure

Romi/
├── motor_driver.py
├── encoder.py
├── linesensors.py
├── IMU.py
└── tasks/
